people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
translations.bsb: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
translations.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
translations.asv: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent forth our fathers the first time.
